name: silvershop/catalog-data
description: Shared normalised product-data mapper for SilverShop (CMS 6): a CatalogProductData value object + factory that turns a Product/Variation into channel-ready fields (feedId, price/sale, currency, stock-driven availability, images, brand, GTIN/MPN, condition, category path). The one source of truth consumed by the product-feed, SEO and conversion-tracking modules.

suggest.silvershop/product-identity: Adds GTIN/MPN master data; read guarded for the catalog gtin()/mpn() fields.
suggest.silvershop/brands: Adds the product Brand; read guarded for the catalog brand() field.
suggest.silvershop/product-gallery: Adds a product image gallery; read guarded for additional images.
suggest.silvershop/colors: Adds colour variant attributes surfaced through the catalog attributes() map.
